description.en: Keep the Mac awake: until you stop it, for a time, or while a terminal's command runs. Each option explained in plain words; no process is spawned.
description.ja: Mac をスリープさせない: 止めるまで、指定した時間、またはターミナルのコマンドが動いている間。各オプションをわかりやすく説明します。プロセスは起動しません。

scopes.power:read: See what keeps this Mac awake through cmux, and follow changes.
scopes.power:write: Keep the Mac awake when you choose a preset, and stop it when you choose Stop. cmux holds the power assertion; the app never runs a process.

optionalScopes.terminal:read: List the terminals that run a command, so you can keep the Mac awake until that command finishes.
optionalScopes.mcp:expose: Let agents keep the Mac awake while their own terminal's command runs.
optionalScopes.actions:run: Open the Caffeinate pane from the menu bar.

handles.terminal: Keep the Mac awake while the command in this terminal runs.
handles.task: Keep the Mac awake until this task is done.
